metadata.question: Does the tropical rainfall rate increase in the western Pacific Ocean during 2009 compared to 1998?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy - Collection: NASA’s TRMM/IMERG or the extended GPM “NASA/GPM_L3/IMERG_V06” rainfall rate (mm/hr). - Dates: 1998-01-01 – 1998-12-31 and 2009-01-01 – 2009-12-31. - Region: Western Pacific Ocean (roughly 120°E–160°E, 10°S–20°N). 2. Masking strategy - Rainfall products are already masked over land by design; no extra cloud-mask needed. - We will simply sum annual rainfall (mean rate × hours) to compare total rainfall. 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero vs Null/Error - Check collection size first → C1 if 0. - After reducing total rainfall, verify result is a finite positive number; null/NaN → C3. - If 2009 total > 1998 total → A, else B. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time wPac = ee.Geometry.Rectangle(120, -10, 160, 20) years = {'1998': ('1998-01-01', '1999-01-01'), '2009': ('2009-01-01', '2010-01-01')} # 2. Acquire & Check def annual_rain(year): col = (ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GPM_L3/IMERG_V06') .select('precipitationCal') .filterDate(*years[year]) .filterBounds(wPac)) n = col.size().getInfo() if n == 0: print(f"{year} Images: 0") return None total = (col.sum() .multiply(0.5) # half-hourly → hours .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=wPac, scale=10000, maxPixels=1e9) .get('precipitationCal') .getInfo()) return total r98 = annual_rain('1998') r09 = annual_rain('2009') # 3. Validate if r98 is None or r09 is None: print("C1") elif r98 < 0 or r09 < 0 or ee.Algorithms.IsNaN(r98).getInfo() or ee.Algorithms.IsNaN(r09).getInfo(): print("C3") else: print(f"1998 mm: {r98:.1e} 2009 mm: {r09:.1e}") print("A" if r09 > r98 else "B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time
wPac = ee.Geometry.Rectangle(120, -10, 160, 20)
years = {'1998': ('1998-01-01', '1999-01-01'),
         '2009': ('2009-01-01', '2010-01-01')}

# 2. Acquire & Check
def annual_rain(year):
    col = (ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GPM_L3/IMERG_V06')
           .select('precipitationCal')
           .filterDate(*years[year])
           .filterBounds(wPac))
    n = col.size().getInfo()
    if n == 0:
        print(f"{year} Images: 0")
        return None
    total = (col.sum()
             .multiply(0.5)  # half-hourly → hours
             .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
                           geometry=wPac, scale=10000,
                           maxPixels=1e9)
             .get('precipitationCal')
             .getInfo())
    return total

r98 = annual_rain('1998')
r09 = annual_rain('2009')

# 3. Validate
if r98 is None or r09 is None:
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
elif r98 < 0 or r09 < 0 or ee.Algorithms.IsNaN(r98).getInfo() or ee.Algorithms.IsNaN(r09).getInfo():
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
else:
    print(f"1998 mm: {r98:.1e}  2009 mm: {r09:.1e}")
    print("<answer>A</answer>" if r09 > r98 else "<answer>B</answer>")
